title: Automated Materials Data and Knowledge Extraction using Machine Learning and Large Language Models
title_zh: 使用机器学习与大型语言模型进行材料数据与知识自动提取

paragraphs.en: 综述回顾了从规则流水线到LLM智能体提取材料数据与知识的演进，并指出关键开放挑战。 Over the past decade, substantial efforts have been devoted to developing machine learning (ML) methods for extracting materials data and, where possible, materials knowledge directly from the scientific literature. This review traces the evolution of these methods from heuristic, rule-based pipelines through natural language processing (NLP) models and transformer-based encoders to, lastly, large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems capable of extracting materials information across multiple modalities, including text, tables, and figures. Beside construction of large, queryable materials databases and knowledge graphs that support downstream materials discovery, we discuss how these advances have enabled new capabilities, such as, generic question answering across materials science, AI co-scientists and chatbots for research assistance, and closed-loop optimization and discovery when integrated with autonomous laboratories. We critically assess the datasets generated using these approaches, their extraction accuracy and computational costs, and the respective strengths and limitations of different methodologies, and even provide practical guidelines for developing more reliable and scalable materials data extraction pipelines. Finally, we identify key open challenges, including the extraction of full materials structure-property-processing-performance tetrahedron at the sample level, the scarcity of reliable benchmark datasets for systematic evaluation, and the resolution of non-standard materials terminology across different document modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 综述回顾了从规则流水线到LLM智能体提取材料数据与知识的演进，并指出关键开放挑战。在过去十年中，大量研究工作致力于开发机器学习（ML）方法，以直接从科学文献中提取材料数据，并在可能的情况下提取材料知识。 本综述追溯了这些方法的演进历程：从启发式、基于规则的流水线，到自然语言处理（NLP）模型和基于Transformer的编码器，最后到大语言模型（LLM）以及能够跨文本、表格和图像等多种模态提取材料信息的智能体系统。 除了构建支持下游材料发现的大型可查询材料数据库和知识图谱之外，我们还讨论了这些进展如何催生了新的能力，例如跨材料科学的通用问答、用于科研辅助的AI科学家助手和聊天机器人，以及与自主实验室集成后的闭环优化与发现。 我们批判性地评估了用这些方法生成的数据集、其提取准确性和计算成本，以及不同方法各自的优势与局限，甚至为开发更可靠、更可扩展的材料数据提取流水线提供了实用指南。 最后，我们指出了关键开放挑战，包括在样品层面提取完整的材料结构-性能-工艺-成分四面体、缺乏用于系统评估的可靠基准数据集，以及解决不同文档模态间非标准材料术语的问题。
